children: to further enhance its capital structure, the company said Tuesday.

The company amended, extended, and upsized its senior secured revolving credit facility and recently completed a $1.0B notes offering. Together, the moves represented ~$1.3B of total debt capital raised since June 30, 2026.

Under the amended revolving credit facility, total commitments increased to $4.2B from $3.9B, and the maturity was extended to September 2031 from October 2029. The interest rate on the facility was reduced to SOFR + 1.650%-1.775% from the previous rate of SOFR + 1.875%.

OCIC also completed the notes offering consisting of $700M of 6.250% notes due 2029 and an additional $300M of 6.550% notes due 2031. The additional 2031 notes are an add-on to $500M of the same note issued in June, boosting the total principal amount of those notes to $800M. The net proceeds were used in part to repay existing debt and further optimize OCIC's liability structure.
"Together, these transactions further enhance our liquidity and financial flexibility, positioning OCIC to capitalize on an increasingly attractive lending environment," said CEO Craig W. Packer.
